Ready to make your mark in the world of investments? Spend an unforgettable summer at Invesco alongside a select group of driven students. Our 9-week Summer Internship Program kicks off in June 2027 and offers you the chance to dive into the fast-paced world of investments, learn from industry pros, and build connections that will last a lifetime.

In this internship, you’ll get hands-on experience, one-on-one mentorship, and the inside scoop on what it’s really like to work at a global investment firm. As part of a Summer Internship Program cohort, you will have a variety of initiatives to keep you engaged throughout the summer including orientation, networking events, development workshops, and volunteer activities. You’ll work side-by-side with talented teams to learn about the business.

Here’s the best part: crush your internship, and you could be eligible for a full-time offer to join our Early Career Program after graduation!

Overview of Department/Team
The Investment Technology team supports a portfolio of critical middle- and back-office applications, as well as the technology platforms for the Invesco Trust Company business. The team combines business analysis, engineering, and Agile delivery leadership to ensure stability, enhancement, and strategic evolution of systems that support investment operations, data management, fund administration, trust services, and operational processing.

Partnering closely with business stakeholders, operations teams, vendors, and technology organizations, the team delivers technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, strengthen controls, enhance data quality, and support regulatory and business objectives. The team is responsible for key platforms including CWp, CADIS, EREF, SREF, FundStation, and several others, driving both day-to-day support and long-term transformation initiatives across Invesco's investment operations landscape.
